description: This file defines the partial class CalculatorScientificAngleButtons, which manages the UI logic for angle mode buttons (radians, degrees, grads) in a calculator app, including handling button presses, visual state changes, and toggling scientific notation mode.

classes.name: CalculatorScientificAngleButtons
classes.description: A sealed partial class managing angle mode buttons and related UI logic in the calculator app.

methods.name: CalculatorScientificAngleButtons
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component and setting initial error visual state.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Property returning the ViewModel associated with this view, cast to StandardCalculatorViewModel.

methods.name: ButtonPressed
methods.description: Property returning a command that triggers OnAngleButtonPressed when executed.

methods.name: IsErrorVisualState
methods.description: Property managing the visual state indicating error status, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: OnAngleButtonPressed
methods.description: Handles angle button presses, switching angle modes and updating button visibility and focus.

methods.name: FToEButton_Toggled
methods.description: Handles toggling of the F to E (scientific notation) button, invoking ViewModel method.
